individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A contains only fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge) with no averaged/summary plot.
The bar graphs (JC-1 relative intensity Green/Red and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean +/- error bars without overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a Western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot.
The signal intensity bar graphs for SDH and COX staining show means with error bars and sample sizes indicated in the bars, but no individual data points are overlaid.
The FACS panels are histograms of cell counts vs TMRM intensity, showing the full measured distribution rather than an averaged summary statistic, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
